items.title: Schuller Gunther — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I talked about Alvino Rey. They all had great bands at various times...

ctx.x: As I say, 30,000. Now it would be 8-million. So the only way that I feel that I can still do something of some value is to, first of all, be much more selective. I cannot discuss everybody. I discussed every damn and mostly neglected jazz orchestra in the swing era. I talked about Bob Chester. I talked about Alvino Rey. They all had great bands at various times, and then they didn’t succeed and they went commercial again. I wrote almost about every – and every territory band that almost no-one ever wrote about.…
You’ve given us a lot as it stands right now.
